about: Reviewed list for community_assets.py (decision 44, decided by FPR on 2026-10-18). Private residences on the National Register, and any listing whose name holds a street address or house number, are counted in their municipio but not drawn, and their names are not published. A listing whose name matches community_assets.RESIDENCE_NAME or ADDRESS_NAME must be in 'public' (drawn, with the reason) or in 'residence' (counted only); one in neither is counted only until a person reviews it. 'residence' may also hold listings the patterns miss. Residences are listed by NPS reference number only, so this file does not repeat their names. NPS gives no ownership or use field, so each entry was decided by hand from the name, the resource type and public descriptions; 'borderline' marks the ones to confirm.
